Agronomy Standard Operating Procedures

Crop Production Guides

Complete package of practices, sowing schedules, irrigation stages & harvesting protocols.

Kharif Season 150 – 165 Days

Cotton (Bt Cotton / Shankar-6)

Deep black cotton soil. Optimum sowing window June 15 - July 15. Spacing 4ft x 1.5ft. Potential yield 14-18 Qtl/Acre.

Yield: 16 Qtl/Acre
Kharif / Summer 110 – 120 Days

Groundnut (GG-20 / GJG-32)

Well-drained sandy loam soil. Gypsum application at pegging stage mandatory for bold pod development.

Yield: 18-22 Qtl/Acre
Rabi Season 100 – 115 Days

Cumin (Gujarat Cumin-4 / GC-4)

Sown in November. High cash crop sensitive to cloudy weather and blight (Chharo). Preventative copper spray key.

Yield: 5-7 Qtl/Acre

Sowing Period
June 15 – July 15
Seed Rate

Spacing
120 cm x 45 cm

Crop Growth Milestones & Management

0 - 25 Days: Sowing & Emergence

Seed treatment with Imidacloprid 600 FS @ 5ml/kg to protect against early sucking pests (thrips, aphids).

25 - 60 Days: Square & Vegetative Phase

First top dressing of Urea @ 30kg/acre. Nipping of terminal shoot at 80-90 cm height to promote lateral branching.

60 - 110 Days: Peak Flowering & Boll Formation

Critical irrigation window. Avoid water stress. Install pheromone traps and monitor for Pink Bollworm.

110 - 160 Days: Boll Bursting & Picking

Pick clean cotton during morning hours when dew has evaporated. Store in dry, well-ventilated godown.

Zero-Budget Natural Farming & Organic Formulations

Compost & Organic Formulations

Traditional fermented bio-inputs, liquid organic nutrients, and microbial enrichers.

Liquid Bio-Fertilizer

Jeevamrut (Liquid Microbial Culture)

200L barrel recipe using desi cow dung, cow urine, jaggery & besan. Ferments in 5-7 days. Applied @ 200L/Acre via drip or flood.

Cost: ₹ 120 / Acre
Solid Bio-Fertilizer

Ghan Jeevamrut (Solid Form)

Dried microbial cakes made with 100kg cow dung and Jeevamrut slurry. Replaces synthetic DAP at sowing. Shelf life 6 months.

Cost: ₹ 350 / Acre
Botanical Bio-Pesticide

Neemastra (Sucking Pest Control)

Extract of crushed neem leaves and cow urine fermented for 48 hours. Controls whitefly, aphids, and jassids effectively.

Cost: ₹ 80 / Acre

Add Organic Formulation

Natural farming recipe registry

Jeevamrut Preparation Protocol

Zero-Budget Natural Farming (ZBNF) Formulation

Barrel Volume
200 Litres Water
Fermentation Time
5 to 7 Days in Shade

Required Ingredients:

  • Fresh Desi Cow Dung: 10 kg
  • Desi Cow Urine: 10 Litres
  • Organic Jaggery (Gur): 2 kg
  • Gram Flour (Besan): 2 kg
  • Uncultivated Virgin Bund Soil: 1 Handful (serves as microbial inoculum)

Step-by-Step Stirring Instructions:

Mix all ingredients into the barrel with 190L water. Stir clockwise with a wooden stick for 5 minutes twice daily (morning and evening). Keep covered with a wet jute gunny bag. After 7 days, strain through cotton cloth and apply via drip irrigation or direct flood.

JP
Jayesh Patel Sudavad · Farmer 2 hours ago

Yellowing leaves in 65-day cotton crop after canal irrigation. Which spray is best?

After third watering, bottom leaves are turning bright yellow with minor leaf curl. Soil is medium black. Should I spray 19:19:19 NPK or micronutrient mixture?

Verified Agronomist Solution · Dr. Hiren Vora (JAU Junagadh)

This is Magnesium deficiency combined with minor nitrogen leaching. Spray Magnesium Sulphate @ 50g + Urea @ 100g per 15L pump. Leaves will recover green pigmentation within 4 days.

Publish New Agronomy Guide

Category 5 min read

Guide Title

Published by AnkurMitra Agronomy Panel
Summary text here

Key Cultural & Preventive Practices

  • Deep summer ploughing to expose hibernating pupae to solar heat and predators.
  • Install Delta Pheromone traps @ 5 traps per acre at 45 DAS to monitor initial moth flights.
  • Observe economic threshold level (ETL): 1 live larva per 10 green bolls or 8 moths/trap/night for 3 consecutive nights.
  • Rotate chemical mode of action (IRAC groups) to prevent insecticide resistance.
